name: Tinker: I'm The Creator Now (503534) grants its AP/SP buff from summon damage (#7433)
contract: Issue #7433: 'I'm The Creator Now [503534]' - 'Talent does not add any AP or SP. Does not apply buff.' Expected: '40% Chance to Apply Buff of +9 to AP and SP, stacking 3 times.' Spell.dbc 503534 is passive, ProcChance 40, with effect 0 SPELL_EFFECT_ASCENSION_APPLY_AURA_TO_SUMMONS (190) carrying aura 42 SPELL_AURA_PROC_TRIGGER_SPELL and EffectTriggerSpell 503549. 503549 ('I'm The Creator Now') is two SPELL_EFFECT_APPLY_AURA effects on TARGET_UNIT_MASTER (27): aura 344 SPELL_AURA_ASCENSION_MOD_ATTACK_POWER_FLAT and aura 345 SPELL_AURA_MOD_SPELL_POWER_FLAT, EffectBasePoints 8 with DieSides 1, StackAmount 3 and a 30 s duration; its Targets field is 0, so only the master-targeted effects, never an explicit unit target, can carry it. Matching the issue's '+9', 503549 resolves to 9 at the reporter's level 34, and to 20 at level 80 where SpellEffectInfo::CalcValue adds 0.25 per level above BaseLevel 15 up to MaxLevel 60. The delivery is the Tinker package: AscensionTinkerContracts.cpp makes 503534 a TinkerDrivers dummy aura on the player, and AscensionTinkerEvents.cpp DeviceEvent() rolls Chance(player,503534) on every damage event from an owned device, which then has the summon cast 503549 so its master-targeted effects land on the summon's owner. The Mechano-Bear build 803405 summons the permanent device 60671, which AscensionTinkerSummons.cpp::Scale() gives aura 707698 - the aura whose script dispatches DeviceEvent. A level 80 Tinker that learns 503534, summons the bear and sends it at a dummy must therefore see 503549 land on itself, and the same setup without the talent must not. aura_amount is the AuraEffect's own amount, which this core scales by the aura's stack count, so the scenario records it instead of asserting a stack-invariant number; the per-stack value of 20 (both effects) for 1, 2 and 3 stacks was measured directly against this fix.
